استنجيت (form X)
# اِسْتَنْجَيْتُ (istanjaytu) /is.tan.d͡ʒaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اِسْتَنْجَيْتَ (istanjayta) /is.tan.d͡ʒaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اِسْتَنْجَيْتِ (istanjayti) /is.tan.d͡ʒaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَنْجَى (istanjā)
# اُسْتُنْجِيتُ (ustunjītu) /us.tun.d͡
